title: ID0420951-DC/Si-D/DE-[MP / P2 170000123 ERK] Error Message
description:
Reported behavior/issue:
Charging point 1 is unavailable and cannot be resolved even by rebooting (remotely).
The error history frequently displays the status "unavailable" and "faulty."
The error code "InternalError" - "Error in the internal hardware and software component" - is regularly displayed.

additional_info.subject: RE: ID0420951-DC/Si-D/DE-[MP / P2 170000123 ERK] Error Message CRM:02679000164
additional_info.body:
Dear Team
I have checked the logs on SCB that you mentioned in the trailing mail, and after analyzing them,
we are encountering the following error:
"Error polling coap://10.20.17.101:5683/state Error: No reply in 4.25s,"
which indicates that the SECC Lite is unable to communicate with the controller.
To address this issue, we recommend planning a site intervention.
Please ensure to carry the following items during the visit:
Ethernet cable
SECC Lite unit compatible with Charging Point 1
Initially, please check the wiring and connections as per the schematics.
If replacing the Ethernet cable does not resolve the issue, you may proceed with replacing the SECC Lite.
Additionally, please note that the charger is an ERK (Electrical Room Kiosk) type,
so it is mandatory to strictly follow all EHS (Environment, Health, and Safety) guidelines.
Please ensure that only trained and authorized technicians perform the work.
